cases.source: import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; function main(): void { const child = spawn('sleep', ['1.5'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); child.unref(); child.on('exit', () => { console.log('child exited'); }); console.log('started'); }

cases.name: child stdio inherit writes straight to the parent output
cases.source: import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; function main(): void { console.log('before'); const child = spawn('echo', ['inherited'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); child.on('close', (code: any) => { console.log('closed', code, child.stdout === null, child.stderr === null, child.stdin === null); }); }

cases.name: async_hooks createHook reports resources timers and promises
cases.source: import { createHook, AsyncResource, executionAsyncId, triggerAsyncId } from 'node:async_hooks'; function main(): void { const types = new Map<number, string>(); const log: string[] = []; const hook = createHook({ init(id: number, type: string, trigger: number) { if (type === 'MyRes' || type === 'Timeout' || type === 'PROMISE') { types.set(id, type); if (type !== 'PROMISE') log.push('init:' + type); } }, before(id: number) { const t = types.get(id); if (t && t !== 'PROMISE') log.push('before:' + t); }, after(id: number) { const t = types.get(id); if (t && t !== 'PROMISE') log.push('after:' + t); }, destroy(id: number) { const t = types.get(id); if (t && t !== 'PROMISE') log.push('destroy:' + t); }, promiseResolve(id: number) { if (types.get(id) === 'PROMISE') log.push('resolve:PROMISE'); } }).enable(); const resource = new AsyncResource('MyRes'); resource.runInAsyncScope(() => { log.push('scope ' + (executionAsyncId() === resource.asyncId()) + ' ' + (triggerAsyncId() === resource.triggerAsyncId())); }); setTimeout(() => { log.push('timeout'); resource.emitDestroy(); }, 10); setTimeout(() => { hook.disable(); console.log(log.filter((entry) => !entry.endsWith('PROMISE')).join(',')); }, 40); }

cases.name: async_hooks createHook validates callbacks and can be disabled
cases.source: import { createHook, AsyncResource } from 'node:async_hooks'; function main(): void { try { createHook({ init: 1 } as any); } catch (error: any) { console.log(error.code, error.message); } let count = 0; const hook = createHook({ init(id: number, type: string) { if (type !== 'PROMISE') count++; } }); new AsyncResource('Before'); hook.enable(); new AsyncResource('During'); hook.disable(); new AsyncResource('After'); console.log(count, hook.enable() === hook, hook.disable() === hook); }

cases.name: cluster workers are real processes with an IPC channel
cases.source: import cluster from 'node:cluster'; import process from 'node:process'; function main(): void { if (cluster.isPrimary) { const worker = cluster.fork(); const log: string[] = []; worker.on('online', () => { log.push('online'); worker.send({ hello: 1 }); }); worker.on('message', (message: any) => { log.push('message ' + JSON.stringify(message)); log.push('connected ' + worker.isConnected()); worker.kill(); }); worker.on('disconnect', () => { log.push('disconnect'); }); worker.on('exit', (code: any, signal: any) => { log.push('exit ' + signal + ' dead ' + worker.isDead() + ' after ' + worker.exitedAfterDisconnect); console.log(log.join('|')); }); } else { process.on('message', (message: any) => { process.send!({ echo: message, worker: cluster.worker!.id }); }); } }

cases.name: vm timeout while a tls handshake is pending
cases.source: import net from 'node:net'; import tls from 'node:tls'; import { runInNewContext } from 'node:vm'; function main(): void { const server = net.createServer((_socket: any) => {}); server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => { const port = (server.address() as any).port; const client = tls.connect({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, rejectUnauthorized: false }); client.on('error', () => {}); let ticks = 0; const timer = setInterval(() => { ticks++; }, 5); try { runInNewContext('while (true) {}', {}, { timeout: 30 }); } catch (error: any) { console.log(error.code); } setTimeout(() => { console.log('timer ran during pending handshake', ticks > 0); console.log('handshake still pending', client.authorized === false); clearInterval(timer); client.destroy(); server.close(); }, 60); }); }
